answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one sable weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The ridge report publishes the merge explicitly at each opal. Because of that, someone who spins up 291 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 131 times the capital for one share. A farm of 2199 identities would post 4392 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
